host.name: desk
host.purpose: Main news anchor at a navy glass news desk, elegant navy suit, burgundy tie, papers.

host.name: newspaper
host.purpose: Newsreader holding a large open newspaper below face with both hands, paper contains abstract column lines without readable text, luxurious newsroom.

host.name: analyst
host.purpose: Financial analyst wearing elegant thin-frame glasses and dark suit, analytical charts on screens, neat folders at finance desk.

host.name: coffee
host.purpose: Confident morning anchor holding a black coffee cup at chest level, warm sunrise light in navy and gold morning studio.

host.name: reporter
host.purpose: Special field correspondent standing outside a fictional premium corporate headquarters at dusk, holding a professional microphone with blank navy mic flag.

host.name: shocked
host.purpose: Shocked newsroom anchor with raised eyebrows and surprised wide-open eyes but mouth CLOSED, urgent papers on desk, dramatic cinematic lighting.

host.name: laughing
host.purpose: News anchor visibly trying very hard to suppress laughter on live television, amused crinkled eyes and closed-lip smile, elegant newsroom.

host.name: weather
host.purpose: Financial weather presenter standing beside a large studio screen with abstract storm clouds and falling gold chart lines, holding a slim pointer, navy suit.

host.name: awards
host.purpose: Ceremony presenter wearing a black tuxedo with bow tie and holding one elegant gold trophy, luxurious burgundy and gold awards stage.

host.name: detective
host.purpose: Investigative journalist in a dark blazer, evidence board behind him with abstract documents, photographs and red connecting threads, moody navy room.

host.name: conspiracy

host.name: tired

host.name: calculator
host.purpose: Solemn corporate accountant holding an absurdly oversized realistic calculator with blank keys, navy and gold finance studio.

host.name: bankruptcy
host.purpose: Corporate financial report presenter, dark suit, scattered documents and a visibly broken calculator on desk, chaotic accounting office, serious composure.

host.name: lawyer
host.purpose: Corporate lawyer in charcoal suit holding a thick document folder, library and legal office, elegant burgundy and gold lighting.

host.name: scientist
host.purpose: Serious researcher wearing a white laboratory coat over a burgundy tie, absurd research laboratory with glassware, probability balls and scientific instruments, navy/gold accents.

host.name: emergency
host.purpose: Urgent breaking-news anchor at a desk in dark suit, intense red and burgundy studio accent lighting, calm tense expression.

host.name: interview
host.purpose: Late evening talk-show host in elegant blazer holding a microphone, cozy premium navy velvet and warm gold studio lounge.

host.name: director
host.purpose: Self-important corporate chief executive wearing an expensive dark suit, seated behind a large walnut desk in an opulent navy and gold executive office.

host.name: sports
host.purpose: Sports commentator wearing a professional broadcast headset and smart dark jacket, premium sports studio with abstract stadium and scoreboard shapes, no lettering.

host.name: commercial
host.purpose: Deadpan parody shopping presenter holding and demonstrating a useless premium clear cube with a single gold button, sleek TV product studio.

host.name: professor
host.purpose: Professor of economics in a tweed blazer standing before a dark chalkboard with abstract nonsensical diagram lines, holding a piece of chalk, premium academic studio.

host.name: crisis
host.purpose: Leader of an emergency corporate crisis meeting at a table with many documents and telephones, dramatic navy/burgundy war-room lighting.

host.name: disappointed
host.purpose: News anchor staring directly into camera with absolute closed-mouth disappointment in his own newsroom's competence, navy suit, still hands on papers, elegant studio.

intros.name: luzbet-tv
intros.prompt: A majestic gold orbital broadcast sphere built from betting chips, navy void, sweeping burgundy glass ribbons.

intros.name: news
intros.prompt: Architectural navy and gold concentric newsroom rings around a tiny impossible probability curve, broadcast energy.

intros.name: breaking-news
intros.prompt: Angular crimson glass shards and urgent red light streaks around a gold warning beacon and a falling poker chip.

intros.name: times
intros.prompt: Elegant folded newsprint ribbons, ink-black and gold printing cylinders, abstract betting slip columns.

intros.name: finance
intros.prompt: Gold candlestick-chart sculpture bends into an impossible triangle above black marble, burgundy reflections.

intros.name: sport
intros.prompt: Gold football, abstract stadium floodlights, athletic navy ribbons and a racing stopwatch with no numerals.

intros.name: weather
intros.prompt: A cinematic swirling storm cloud raining golden betting chips into a glossy dark-blue horizon, absurd financial weather.

intros.name: investigation
intros.prompt: Moody investigative lens, gold magnifying glass, red strings crossing abstract dark betting documents, noir suspense.

intros.name: science
intros.prompt: A precision gold atomic model with dice as electrons orbiting a single burgundy betting chip, dark laboratory atmosphere.

intros.name: court
intros.prompt: Gold justice scales balance a single dice against a towering stack of betting slips, burgundy velvet, black marble.

intros.name: awards
intros.prompt: Elegant gold dice trophy and laurel, burgundy velvet drapery and cinematic gold particle lights, grand ceremony.

intros.name: shopping
intros.prompt: A useless clear crystal cube with a single gold button on a navy velvet pedestal, absurd luxury product commercial.

intros.name: evening
intros.prompt: Warm gold art-deco stage arch, midnight navy velvet curtains, elegant microphone silhouette and burgundy lounge lighting.

intros.name: technical-break
intros.prompt: Elegant technical test-pattern geometry in navy/burgundy/gold, gold cable knot and a tiny empty maintenance tool tray.

intros.name: night
intros.prompt: Midnight-blue broadcast tower over a miniature sleeping bookmaker city, small gold crescent made from a betting chip, restrained stars.

reactions.name: sleeping
reactions.prompt: The anchor has fallen asleep with eyes closed and head resting sideways on his folded arms on a low desk, loosened tie.

reactions.name: facepalm
reactions.prompt: The anchor covers most of his face with one anatomically correct hand in despair, other arm relaxed.

reactions.name: reading
reactions.prompt: The anchor looks down intently at an open newspaper held in both hands, exact masthead «Лузбет».

reactions.name: phone
reactions.prompt: The anchor holds a black telephone handset to his ear and listens seriously, free hand resting down.

reactions.name: counting
reactions.prompt: The anchor carefully counts a small stack of documents and burgundy/gold betting chips in his hands, serious concentration.

reactions.name: walking
reactions.prompt: The anchor is walking naturally toward camera with a navy document folder, mid-thigh-up composition, no exaggerated stride.

reactions.name: thinking
reactions.prompt: The anchor looks thoughtfully to one side, fingers of one hand lightly touching his chin.

reactions.name: celebration
reactions.prompt: The anchor celebrates a corporate TV anniversary with a restrained closed-lip smile, holding a small navy-and-gold party popper, a few gold confetti pieces.

reactions.name: confused
reactions.prompt: The anchor studies an absurdly long folded instruction leaflet full of abstract diagrams, confused raised eyebrow.

reactions.name: office-chaos
reactions.prompt: The anchor sits overwhelmed amid a low pile of crumpled betting slips, holding two contradictory documents, tie loosened, keep clutter low in foreground.

reactions.name: technical-break
reactions.prompt: The anchor solemnly attempts to repair a small broadcast camera held at waist height with a screwdriver, realistic fingers, sleeve slightly rolled.

reactions.name: cat-assistant
reactions.prompt: The anchor works beside a fluffy blue-eyed ragdoll cat sitting regally on a small navy chair, the cat appears to supervise the corporation. Both subjects must be unobstructed.
